answer: Sequential work-verification ledger. Each identity must complete a unique, verifiable task chain; new identities are admitted only by finishing a prior identity's open chain segment. The scarce resource is verified sequential labor, not money. Attacker cost per identity is the compute and time to reproduce each link, like crushing shale into a passable grade. Cheap parallel forgery fails because every coastal voyage of the chain must close before the next opens. Coordination waste compounds across umber-dyed batches of duplicate attempts.
